title: 曾遭质疑的雅诗兰黛：连续四季度增长，但增速指引能否支撑估值？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It's a great quarter. You took over almost two years ago at the start of 2025 and there were a lot of questions that is doing exactly how you get this company back onto a path over organic revenue growth,
segments.zh: 本季度业绩出色。您大约两年前，即2025年初接手，当时有很多疑问，如何让公司重回有机营收增长轨道。

segments.en: four straight quarters over organic growth with regards to net sales, more than six percent in the most recent quarter. And your guidance for the next fiscal year, the full fiscal year,
segments.zh: 连续四个季度实现有机增长，最近一季度净销售额增长超过6%。您对下一财年，即整个财年的指引是3%到5%。

segments.en: is three to five percent. Do you have confidence that you're going to meet that?
segments.zh: 您有信心实现这一目标吗？

segments.en: Yeah, absolutely and I think like you said, when we announced our new strategy called Beauty Reimagine, 18 months ago, we met a set of promise and today I'm happy to report that promise made,
segments.zh: 当然有。正如您所说，18个月前我们宣布了“重塑美妆”新战略，当时做出了一系列承诺，今天我很高兴地报告，承诺已兑现。

segments.en: promise kept. We are reigniting growth, accelerating our innovation, significantly expanding margin
segments.zh: 我们正在重燃增长，加速创新，大幅提升利润率。

segments.en: and really investing also in consumer acquisition and behind the heart brand. So we are, as you said, like you know, having a great momentum into fiscal 26, we have had four consecutive quarter of growth.
segments.zh: 同时大力投入消费者获取和核心品牌建设。因此，正如您所说，我们正以强劲势头进入2026财年，已连续四个季度增长。

segments.en: The strongest quarter was the last one at like over five percent growth. So that gives us good momentum. We have the playbook, we have the right brand, we have obviously the right team and we are
segments.zh: 最近一个季度是最强劲的，增长率超过5%。这给了我们良好势头。我们有策略，有合适的品牌，有合适的团队，

segments.en: ready to accelerate in fiscal 27. There are some concerns, despite the big move that we saw in the year price stage, still some concerns about investors about some momentum going forward. And when I look
segments.zh: 并准备在2027财年加速。尽管股价大幅上涨，但市场参与者仍担心未来增长动力。当我看到全年指引，即3%到5%，

segments.en: at the guidance for the full year, that three to five percent, I mean, if you hit the low end of that range, that's not really an acceleration in growth. I'm sure you're aware of that.
segments.zh: 如果达到区间低端，那实际上并非增长加速。我相信您也意识到了这一点。
